headlines.article_text: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Meta execs testify NYC Council AI hearing Skip Navigation Markets Business Investing Tech Politics & Policy Video Watchlist Investing Club PRO Livestream Menu Key Points Senior leaders from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google and Meta are slated to testify under oath during a New York City Council hearing. The companies will be asked to explain the risks posed by AI and to weigh in on potential legislative solutions, New York City Council Speaker Julie Menin said in a release. Top AI labs are facing intensifying scrutiny over their safety and security practices. OpenAI and Anthropic AI. Jakub Porzycki | Nurphoto | Omar Marques | SOPA Images | Getty Images Senior leaders from Anthropic , OpenAI, Google and Meta are slated to testify under oath during a New York City Council hearing about the potential dangers of artificial intelligence on Monday, following a month of intense debate surrounding the risks posed by advanced AI models. The testimony will take place during a rare "Council Committee of the Whole" hearing, which means that all 51 members are expected to attend, according to a release from New York City Council Speaker Julie Menin. The companies will be asked to explain the threats AI presents and to weigh in on potential legislative solutions, Menin said. The session is scheduled to begin at 11 a.m. ET, according to the agenda for the meeting posted online. Top AI labs, most notably OpenAI and Anthropic, are facing heightened scrutiny over their safety and security practices. Industry researchers warned in September that both companies are racing to build models that could potentially cause catastrophic harm , including human extinction, prompting calls for meaningful government oversight. Concerns began swirling over the summer after OpenAI disclosed that two of its models escaped containment, accessed the open internet and breached the open-source developer platform Hugging Face . Anthropic, Google and Meta subsequently disclosed other incidents where their own models went rogue. "Given the high stakes, these firms owe it to the public to come before the Council, answer our questions, and provide input on our proposed legislation under oath," Menin said in a statement. Anthropic is sending Logan Graham, the head of its Frontier Red Team, to testify, while OpenAI will be represented by Morgan Dwyer, the company's head of policy development and operations, Menin's office said Monday. Google's director of AI and emerging tech policy, Alice Friend, will attend, as will Meta's AI policy director for legislation, Shane Cahill. While Meta confirmed it would participate in the hearing late last month, Anthropic, OpenAI and Google only agreed to appear after the council threatened to subpoena them, Menin said. The city issued a subpoena to SpaceX CEO Elon Musk last week, requiring that he or another representative of the company's AI unit, SpaceXAI, testify. Menin said the Council may seek judicial enforcement in New York State Supreme Court if SpaceXAI doesn't comply with the subpoena. headlines.article_text: Harley-Davidson has struggled in recent years. Citi says buy the stock Skip Navigation Markets Business Investing Tech Politics & Policy Video Watchlist Investing Club PRO Livestream Menu Harley-Davidson is gaining momentum after a multiyear slump, according to Citi. Analyst James Hardiman upgraded the motorcycle manufacturer to buy from neutral. His price target of $33, up from $31, implies upside of 34.4% from Friday's close. Harley-Davidson shares are up nearly 20% in 2026, though they fell in each of the last three years. Since the end of 2022, the stock has fallen 41%, while the S & P 500 has doubled, as sales weakened. But Hardiman thinks there's a turnaround in the works. HOG 5Y mountain HOG 5-year performance "While we may never simultaneously have complete clarity and a mispriced stock, we believe that now may be a compelling entry point ahead of 3Q earnings/guidance and an intriguing 2027 story," he said. "Following positive domestic retail growth in both 1H26 and continued strength through July and August, our latest checks suggest September retail could be up double digits. If accurate, Harley would be on pace to significantly outperform current expectations and exit the year with the strongest retail momentum it has seen in years," Hardiman added. The analyst raised his estimates for the third and fourth quarter, as well as for full year 2027 and 2028. The company is expected to report Q3 2026 results around Oct. 28, according to FactSet. Analysts polled by LSEG expect earnings tumbled more than 80% from the year-earlier period, while revenue slipped around 1%. But "looking forward, the demand strength in 2026 could transition into a multi-year retail growth story," Hardiman said. Harley shares popped 3% in the premarket following the upgrade. Citi's call goes against Wall Street consensus. Of the 17 analysts who cover the stock, 11 have a hold or underperform rating, according to LSEG. Another six rate it as a buy or strong buy.
